name: @lutrodev/dsh-roleplay
description: Open-source roleplay plugin suite for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.check: pnpm run check:compat && pnpm run check:dev && pnpm -r --if-present run check
scripts.test: pnpm run test:compat && pnpm run test:dev && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.build:host: tsc -b tsconfig.host.json && pnpm --filter dsh-roleplay-rp-remote run build:host
scripts.build: pnpm run build:host && pnpm -r --if-present --filter '!dsh-roleplay-rp-remote' run build:client && pnpm --filter dsh-roleplay-rp-remote run build:client
scripts.publish:package: pnpm run build:package && npm publish ./.npm-package --access public
scripts.verify: pnpm run check:compat && pnpm run test:compat && pnpm run check:dev && pnpm run test:dev && pnpm -r --if-present run verify
